parameters.query:
SELECT
  (candidate.source_id IS NOT NULL) AS found,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.parqueadero_usuarios pu
    LEFT JOIN public.estudiantes pe ON pe.id = pu.estudiante_id
    LEFT JOIN public.docentes pd ON pd.id = pu.docente_id
    WHERE COALESCE(pe.cedula, pd.cedula, pu.cedula_manual) = input.cedula
  ) AS "alreadyRegistered",
  CASE WHEN candidate.source_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE json_build_object(
    'sourceId', candidate.source_id::int,
    'type', candidate.user_type,
    'identification', candidate.cedula,
    'fullName', candidate.full_name,
    'institutionalEmail', candidate.email
  ) END AS person
FROM (SELECT $1::varchar AS cedula) input
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT source_id, user_type, cedula, full_name, email
  FROM (
    SELECT e.id AS source_id, 'ESTUDIANTE'::varchar AS user_type, e.cedula, e.nombres AS full_name, e.correo AS email, 1 AS priority
    FROM public.estudiantes e WHERE e.cedula = input.cedula
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.id, 'DOCENTE'::varchar, d.cedula, d.nombre_docente, d.correo, 2
    FROM public.docentes d WHERE d.cedula = input.cedula
  ) matches
  ORDER BY priority
  LIMIT 1
) candidate ON TRUE;
